name: Easy Tuna Noodle Casserole with Peas, Zucchini & Parmesan-Bread Crumb Topping

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add noodles, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 5-7 minutes. Drain noodles and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp salt
283 g egg noodles, wide

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and trim zucchini. Halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Peel, halve, and small dice onion.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium zucchini squash
1 medium yellow onion

instructions.primary_message: Preheat an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add zucchini, onion, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until zucchini is just fork-tender, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
2 tsp garlic & herb seasoning
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the zucchini is cooking, place Parmesan, bread crumbs, and seasoning in a small bowl. Stir to combine the topping.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups Parmesan cheese, shredded
1 cup panko bread crumbs
2 tsp garlic & herb seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna, flake with a fork, then add to the skillet along with cooked noodles, peas, soup, and milk. Stir to combine, then sprinkle with Parmesan topping.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (120 g) can chunk light tuna in water
2 cups frozen peas
2 (283 g) can condensed cream of celery soup
1 cup whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Place skillet in the oven and bake until the casserole is warmed through and topping is golden, 35-40 minutes.
To serve, divide casserole between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
